unreleased: Page titles and descriptions no longer say "Authenticate WFB": every page now takes the application's name (nav.brand) and a default description (meta.description) from its translations, and also sets a canonical URL, Open Graph and Twitter tags and the page language. Sign-in, account, administration and diagnostic pages ask search engines not to index them

The contact page can now show an introduction, contact details (email, address, GitHub, LinkedIn) and a note next to the form, all set per deployment; the page moved to /contact (/kontakt redirects there). With nothing configured it is still just the form

Add a CRM module (src/modules/crm), shown to administrators only: a header icon opens the partner list with search, each partner's page with their tasks, and each task's page where invoice PDFs are uploaded, downloaded and deleted - in Czech and English

changes: A manual check of an API documentation now ends with a dialog saying whether the check succeeded or failed (with the reason when it failed) and whether a new version was found, with the new and the previous version

Fix the header bell's unread badge not showing the notification a manual check just created until the page was reloaded: the bell, and the new-version banner on the documentation page, now update right after a check or an upload finds a new version

Add a search row to the API documentation, collection and integration lists: it filters by title and description (words in any order, ignoring case and diacritics) and applies to whichever tab, Public or Mine, is selected

Fix the header on phones when signed in: the app name wrapped and its small tag slid under the notification bell. The header is now more compact on small screens, the name truncates (and gives way to the logo alone on the narrowest phones), and the tag only shows from tablet width up

Fix a documentation version's specification failing with "Document not found" for non-public documents: it is now opened through the signed-in session instead of a bare link. Each version in the history now has Docs (Swagger UI), ReDoc and Download buttons - the first two open a viewer page for that version, and Download saves the file exactly as it was uploaded

Add an event calendar module (src/modules/event_calendar): an "Events" nav link to a list of the next 10 events (thumbnail, title, short description) with "Load more", a sidebar calendar marking event and pinned-event days, a year/month archive opening a month's full listing, event pages at /events/<slug>, and an editors' area with the full WYSIWYG editor
Fix the WYSIWYG editor's toolbar not following the cursor - the heading, bold, font, size and color controls now always show the formatting where the cursor is
Add a shared WYSIWYG HTML editor component (headings, fonts, colors, font sizes, lists, links, images and optional @-mention links) for any page or module that edits rich content
The contact form now sends the language it was filled in, so the confirmation email arrives in that language
Feature modules can now add links to the sitewide footer (footerLinks)

The Stripe payment gate module now publishes the pages a site taking payments must have - About us (provider identification), Terms and conditions, Privacy policy (GDPR) and Cookies - in Czech and English, linked from the footer and filled in from public/legal.json; its pay button now reads "Order and pay", links the terms and privacy policy, and can ask for the digital-content withdrawal waiver

Add a Stripe payment gate module (src/modules/stripe_payment_gate): a reusable Pay button / startCheckout() helper that redirects to Stripe Checkout, and a /platba/vysledek result page showing whether the payment succeeded, is still being confirmed, was canceled, failed, or expired
Fix the notification bell's dropdown running off the left edge of the screen when opened from the new mobile menu
Add a notifications module (src/modules/notifications): a header bell with unread badge and dropdown, available to any application that enables it

Redesign the header so account controls, the language switcher (now a dropdown), the theme toggle, and any module-provided header icon (like the new notifications bell) stay visible everywhere, including in the collapsed mobile view - only page navigation links collapse into the hamburger menu
Fix the header nav overlapping the logo on narrow screens: below the tablet breakpoint it now collapses into a hamburger-triggered dropdown menu
Redesign the home page with a real introduction to API Hub, a hover-reveal grid of feature cards, and a few concrete usage examples, replacing the old placeholder template copy.

Knowledge Base pages now have their own browse and edit screens instead of an inline form on the Collection/Integration page, with a rich-text (WYSIWYG) editor alongside the existing Markdown editor and automatic conversion when switching between them.

Add a documentation link field to API documentation, shown as a clickable link on its page and editable alongside the other fields, and add a Delete button for API documentation and collections you can edit.

Add Knowledge Base sections to Collection and Integration pages: write Markdown notes, rendered safely (sanitized) for every viewer, with an integration always showing the latest pages from its collections plus its own.
Add Integrations pages: create and manage integrations that combine collections and standalone API documentation, with an effective-documents view showing where each document is reachable from.
Add Collections pages: browse public collections, create and manage the collections your teams own, add or remove documents, and subscribe to be notified of new versions.
Add notifications: a header bell with unread badge and dropdown, a new-version banner on documentation pages, and a subscribe/unsubscribe button for any visible API document.
Add API Docs pages: browse public documentation, register new docs by URL or file upload, and view/edit/recheck the documentation your teams own, including its version history.
Add Teams pages: view/create teams, manage members and roles, invite members by email, and accept team invitations.
Add a contact-form module (src/modules/kontaktni_formular) with a /kontakt page and nav link: subject + message, plus a required reply-to email when signed out
Add sun/moon icons to the light/dark toggle switch's thumb, matching whichever mode is active
Add a sitewide footer (linking to withfbraun.com before the copyright line) pinned to the bottom of the viewport even on short pages

Add a pluggable feature-module system: self-contained modules under src/modules/ are auto-discovered and toggled on/off per application via public/modules.json, contributing their own routes, nav links, and translations
Add light/dark theme toggle in the header, with the preference synced to the signed-in user's profile (user_data.darkMode) and a dedicated Appearance section on the Account page
Add /release-news page showing backend and frontend release history side by side, grouped by compatible major.minor version
